title: Roam
tagline: Vertical, poster-bold and loud: slammed type, colour blocks that flip on the beat, stamps and stickers.
description: A 9:16 launch film for a consumer app, built like a gig poster. Four problems slam in on four colour blocks, a question rises out of a mask with a hand-drawn underline, the ask is typed into the app, and on the drop the name lands letter by letter. Then the product, beat by beat: itinerary cards fly in, a plane draws the route between four stops, the price rolls down under budget with a rubber stamp, a boarding pass slides up, BOOKED. Eight cities flash on the beat before the end card. Cut to an original 120 BPM house track, with every slam, whip, stamp and cha-ching on the timeline.
author: Insyd
